narr: Sustained monsoonal flow brought heavy rains and several areas with flash flooding.
ev: Several washouts along Highway 37 south of Rockland including one along King Lane found in NWS storm survey.
Flooding along Trapper Creek Road with excessive runoff from Squaw Creek and Little Squaw Creek drainages. Several inches of rocks, mud and debris on the roadway.
Significant flash flooding occurred across a gravel road, and water was overtopping a small bridge along a paved road in the area of S 2950 E and Heglar Canyon Road west northwest of Heglar.
